Return the original label Entailment (supported), Contradiction (opposed), or NotMentioned (not settled by the document); do not substitute external law for contractual text. Decide the relation relative to the exact original hypothesis, including its negation, not whether the contract contains a prohibition. The same 17 hypotheses are checked on every document. All original text is present, with zero-based original span markers <SPAN i>...</SPAN i>. For supported/opposed hypotheses cite all original evidence span indices for that decision, including independently operative redundant support and necessary governing language. For NotMentioned return an empty evidence list. Treat conditions and exceptions within scope, and distinguish limited permission from universal permission. Give a short public reason (at most 15 words per hypothesis), then report supplied skill IDs actually used. Skills are fallible reusable inspection procedures, not facts about this NDA or automatic verdicts. All skills are visible together; public hypothesis IDs describe applicability, not hidden context isolation. Do not execute further tools, invent citations or rewrite span indices. Return exactly the supplied JSON schema with all 17 original hypothesis keys. For each emit choice, spans, reason, used_skill_ids in that order. The common schema describes permitted values, not answers about this contract. Evidence candidates are fallible, not mandatory citations; make every final label and evidence decision yourself from the complete original contract. External skills here are executable SOURCE ACCESS ONLY, not legal advice. The complete original NDA remains present. SOURCE_LEADS immediately before an original SPAN records factual skill/query locations: match means a literal token-phrase hit, neighbour an explicitly requested window, preamble a possible list introduction. None proves relevance, support, opposition or evidence membership. Skill code/teacher advice is not supplied to you. All skill identities and public scopes are visible together. Missing IDs, empty queries/hits and missing ordinary candidates never mean NotMentioned. Read the full source, reject noisy leads and cite ANY original indices as needed, including outside every retrieval. Make every legal decision yourself. Ordinary candidate indices resolve to their exact original text in the one-copy catalogue; their membership scores are fallible, not legal confidence. Report only supplied matching skill IDs you actually used; [] is always legal.

<SPAN 1>THIS AGREEMENT [the Agreement] is entered into on this [insert number of day] day of [insert Month and Year] by and between:</SPAN 1>
<SPAN 2>1. [Insert official name of the potential partner or participant], having its registered office or based in [insert the Legal Address of the Entity] hereinafter referred to as […] and</SPAN 2>
<SPAN 3>2. [Insert official name of the potential partner or participant], having its registered of-fice or based in [insert the Legal Address of the Entity] hereinafter referred to as [....]</SPAN 3>
<SPAN 4>[Add the identification of all the potential partners and participants that will take part in this Agreement]</SPAN 4>
<SPAN 5>Individually referred to as a Party or collectively as the Parties.</SPAN 5>
<SPAN 6>WHEREAS:</SPAN 6>
<SPAN 7>The Parties hereto desire [to participate in early discussions regarding the entering into future collaboration as a European Funded Project in the field of (….)] or [to submit a proposal for a collaborative project in response to the call (identify the call) under (identi-fy the EU-funded Programme)] or [to evaluate entering into partnership or business col-laboration for the purpose of (identify the undertaking intended to perform)].</SPAN 7>
<SPAN 8>Throughout the aforementioned discussions, Parties may share between themselves proprietary information or Confidential Information under the terms and covenants set forth below.</SPAN 8>
<SPAN 9>THE PARTIES HERETO AGREE AS FOLLOWS:</SPAN 9>
<SPAN 10>1. Confidential Information</SPAN 10>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 11>1.1 </SPAN 11><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 12>For the purposes of this Agreement, Confidential Information means any data or in-formation that is proprietary to or possessed by a Party and not generally known to the public or that has not yet been revealed, whether in tangible or intangible form, when-ever and however disclosed, including, but not limited to:</SPAN 12>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 13>(i) any scientific or technical information, invention, design, process, procedure, formula, improvement, technology or method;</SPAN 13>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 14>(ii) any concepts, samples, reports, data, know-how, works-in-progress, designs, drawings, photographs, development tools, specifications, software pro-grams, source code, object code, flow charts, and databases;</SPAN 14>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 15>(iii) any marketing strategies, plans, financial information, or projections, opera-tions, sales estimates, business plans and performance results relating to the Party’s past, present or future business activities, or those of its affiliates, subsidiaries and affiliated companies;</SPAN 15>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 16>(iv) trade secrets; plans for products or services, and customer or supplier lists;</SPAN 16>
<SPAN 17>(v) any other information that should reasonably be recognised as Confidential Information by the Parties.</SPAN 17>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[2,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 18>1.2 </SPAN 18><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[1,"neighbour"],[2,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 19>The Parties agree hereby that Confidential Information needs not to be novel, unique, patentable, copyrightable or constitutes a trade secret in order to be designated Confi-dential Information and therefore protected.</SPAN 19>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[1,"matched"],[2,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 20>1.3 Confidential Information shall be identified either by marking it, in the case of writ-ten materials, or, in the case of information that is disclosed orally or written materials that are not marked, by notifying the other Party of the confidential nature of the infor-mation. </SPAN 20><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[1,"neighbour"],[2,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 21>Such notification shall be done orally, by e-mail or written correspondence, or via other appropriate means of communication.</SPAN 21>
<SPAN 22>1.4 </SPAN 22><SPAN 23>The Parties hereby acknowledge that the Confidential Information proprietary to each Party has been developed and obtained through great efforts and shall be regarded and kept as Confidential Information.</SPAN 23>
<SPAN 24>1.5 </SPAN 24><SPAN 25>For the purposes of this Agreement, the Party which discloses Confidential Infor-mation within the terms established hereunder to the other Party shall be regarded as the Disclosing Party. </SPAN 25><SPAN 26>Likewise the Party which receives the disclosed Confidential Infor-mation shall be regarded as the Receiving Party.</SPAN 26>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-independent-source-v1":[[0,"preamble"],[1,"preamble"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 27>1.6 Notwithstanding the aforementioned, Confidential Information shall exclude infor-mation that:</SPAN 27>
<SPAN 28>(i) is already in the public domain at the time of disclosure by the Disclosing Par-ty to the Receiving Party or thereafter enters the public domain without any breach of the terms of this Agreement;</SPAN 28>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-independent-source-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 29>(ii) was already known by the Receiving Party before the moment of disclosure (under evidence of reasonable proof or written record of such disclosure);</SPAN 29>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-independent-source-v1":[[1,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 30>(iii) is subsequently communicated to the Receiving Party without any obligation of confidence from a third party who is in lawful possession thereof and un-der no obligation of confidence to the Disclosing Party;</SPAN 30>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-independent-source-v1":[[0,"neighbour"],[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 31>(iv) becomes publicly available by other means than a breach of the confidential-ity obligations by the Receiving Party (not through fault or failure to act by the Receiving Party);</SPAN 31>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-independent-source-v1":[[0,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 32>(v) is or has been developed independently by employees, consultants or agents of the Receiving Party (proved by reasonable means) without violation of the terms of this Agreement or reference or access to any Confidential Infor-mation pertaining to the Parties.</SPAN 32>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-independent-source-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 33>2. Purpose of the Disclosure of Confidential Information</SPAN 33>
<SPAN 34>The Parties will enter into discussions regarding future collaboration toward a European Funded Project in the field of [….] or [will submit a proposal for a collaborative project in response to the call (identify the call) under (identify the EU-funded Programme)] or [will enter into or evaluate alternatives for partnership or collaboration with [name of the other Party or Parties] for the purpose of [identify the undertaking intended to perform or achieve].</SPAN 34>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 35>3. Undertakings of the Parties</SPAN 35>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 36>3.1 </SPAN 36><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 37>In the context of discussions, preparations or negotiations, the Disclosing Party may disclose Confidential Information to the Receiving Party. </SPAN 37><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 38>The Receiving Party agrees to use the Confidential Information solely in connection with purposes contemplated be-tween the Parties in this Agreement and not to use it for any other purpose or without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.</SPAN 38>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 39>3.2 </SPAN 39><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 40>The Receiving Party will not disclose and will keep confidential the information re-ceived, except to its employees, representatives or agents who need to have access to the Confidential Information for the purpose of carrying out their duties in connection with the permitted purposes specified in clause </SPAN 40><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 41>2. </SPAN 41><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 42>The Receiving Party will inform them about the confidential quality of the information provided and will ensure that their agreement is obtained to keep it confidential on the same terms as set forth in this Agreement. </SPAN 42><SPAN 43>Hence the Receiving Party will be responsible for ensuring that the obliga-tions of confidentiality and non-use contained herein will be strictly observed and will assume full liability for the acts or omissions made for its personnel representatives or agents.</SPAN 43>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-limited-use-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 44>3.3 </SPAN 44><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-limited-use-v1":[[0,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 45>The Receiving Party will use the Confidential Information exclusively for the permit-ted purpose stated in clause 2 and not use the information for its own purposes or bene-fit.</SPAN 45>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-limited-use-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 46>3.4 </SPAN 46><SPAN 47>The Receiving Party will not disclose any Confidential Information received to any third parties, except as otherwise provided for herein.</SPAN 47>
<SPAN 48>3.5 </SPAN 48><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 49>The Parties shall treat all Confidential Information with the same degree of care as it accords to its own Confidential Information.</SPAN 49>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[0,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 50>3.6 All Confidential Information disclosed under this Agreement shall be and remain the property of the Disclosing Party and nothing contained in this Agreement shall be con-strued as granting or conferring any rights to such Confidential Information on the other Party. </SPAN 50><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 51>Principally, nothing in this Agreement shall be deemed to grant to the Receiving Party a licence expressly or by implication under any patent, copyright or other intellec-tual property right. </SPAN 51><SPAN 52>The Receiving Party hereby acknowledges and confirms that all exist-ing and future intellectual property rights related to the Confidential Information are exclusive titles of the Disclosing Party. </SPAN 52><SPAN 53>For the sake of clarity based in reciprocity and good faith of the Parties, the Receiving Party will not apply for or obtain any intellectual property protection in respect of the Confidential Information received. </SPAN 53><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 54>Likewise any modifications and improvements thereof by the Receiving Party shall be the sole proper-ty of the Disclosing Party.</SPAN 54>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 55>3.7 </SPAN 55><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[0,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 56>The Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy all copies (in whatever form reproduced or stored), including all notes and derivatives of the Confidential Information disclosed under this Agreement, upon the earlier of </SPAN 56><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 57>(i) the completion or termination of the dealings contemplated in this Agreement; </SPAN 57><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[0,"neighbour"],[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 58>(ii) or the termination of this Agreement;</SPAN 58>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 59>(iii) or at the time the Disclosing Party may request it to the Receiving Party.</SPAN 59>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[1,"matched"]],"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 60>3.8 Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Receiving Party may retain such of its documents as required to comply with mandatory law, provided that such Confidential Information or copies thereof shall be subject to an indefinite confidentiality obligation.</SPAN 60>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 61>3.9 </SPAN 61><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 62>In the event that the Receiving Party is asked to communicate the Confidential In-formation to any judicial, administrative, regulatory authority or similar or obliged to reveal such information by mandatory law, it shall notify promptly the Disclosing Party of the terms of such disclosure and will collaborate to the extent practicable with the Dis-closing Party in order to comply with the order and preserve the confidentiality of the Confidential Information.</SPAN 62>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 63>3.10 </SPAN 63><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 64>The Parties agree that the Disclosing Party will suffer irreparable damage if its Con-fidential Information is made public, released to a third party, or otherwise disclosed in breach of this Agreement and that the Disclosing Party shall be entitled to obtain injunc-tive relief against a threatened breach or continuation of any such breach and, in the event of such a breach, an award of actual and exemplary damages from any court of competent jurisdiction.</SPAN 64>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 65>3.11 </SPAN 65><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 66>The Receiving Party shall immediately notify the Disclosing Party upon becoming aware of any breach of confidence by anybody to whom it has disclosed the Confidential Information and give all necessary assistance in connection with any steps which the Disclosing Party may wish to take prevent, stop or obtain compensation for such a breach or threatened breach.</SPAN 66>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 67>3.12 </SPAN 67><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 68>The Confidential Information subject to this Agreement is made available "as such" and no warranties of any kind are granted or implied with respect to the quality of such information including, but not limited to, its applicability for any purpose, non-infringement of third party rights, accuracy, completeness or correctness.</SPAN 68>
<SPAN 69>3.13 Neither Party is under any obligation under this Agreement to disclose any Confi-dential Information it chooses not to disclose. </SPAN 69><SPAN 70>Further, neither Party shall have any liabil-ity to the other Party resulting from any use of the Confidential Information except with respect to disclosure of such Confidential Information in violation of this Agreement.</SPAN 70>
<SPAN 71>3.14 </SPAN 71><SPAN 72>Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to constitute an agency, partnership, joint venture, or other similar relationship between the Parties.</SPAN 72>
<SPAN 73>4. Miscellaneous</SPAN 73>
<SPAN 74>4.1 Duration and Termination</SPAN 74>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 75>4.1.1 </SPAN 75><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 76>This Agreement shall remain in effect for a term of [number of months or years]. </SPAN 76><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[1,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 77>Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Receiving Party’s duty to hold in confidence Confi-dential Information that was disclosed during the term shall remain in effect indefinitely, save otherwise agreed.</SPAN 77>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 78>4.1.2 </SPAN 78><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 79>If the Parties succeed in the call for proposal referred to in clause 2 and sign the corresponding Grant Agreement (GA) and Consortium Agreement (CA), or enter into partnership under any other kind of collaborative agreement (COA) or association agreement (AA), the non-disclosure provisions of the CA, COA and AA shall [be supple-mented by or supplement or supersede] this Agreement. </SPAN 79><SPAN 80>In the event that non-disclosure provisions are not provided for the said private agreements, this Agreement shall remain in force until the end of the collaboration undertaken or after [months or years] of its termination.</SPAN 80>
<SPAN 81>4.2 Applicable Law and Jurisdiction</SPAN 81>
<SPAN 82>This Agreement shall be construed and interpreted by the laws of [choose the applicable law]. </SPAN 82><SPAN 83>The court of [choose the jurisdiction to settle disputes] shall have jurisdiction.</SPAN 83>
<SPAN 84>4.3 Validity</SPAN 84>
<SPAN 85>If any provisions of this Agreement are invalid or unenforceable, the validity of the re-maining provisions shall not be affected. </SPAN 85><SPAN 86>The Parties shall replace the invalid or unen-forceable provision by a valid and enforceable provision that will meet the purpose of the invalid or unenforceable provision as closely as possible.</SPAN 86>
<SPAN 87>4.4 Subsequent Agreements</SPAN 87>
<SPAN 88>Ancillary agreements, amendments or additions hereto shall be made in writing.</SPAN 88>
<SPAN 89>4.5 Communications</SPAN 89>
<SPAN 90>Any notices or communications required between the Parties shall be delivered by hand, e-mail, or mailed by registered mail to the address of the other Party as indicated above. </SPAN 90><SPAN 91>Any subsequent modification of a Party’s address should be reasonably communicated in advance to the effect of this Agreement.</SPAN 91>
<SPAN 92>5. Competition</SPAN 92>
<SPAN 93>The receipt of Confidential Information pursuant to this Agreement will not prevent or in any way limit either Party from developing, making or marketing products or services that are or may be competitive with the products or services of the other; or providing products or services to others who compete with the other Party; as long as those re-sults have not become from a breach of this Agreement.</SPAN 93>
<SPAN 94>IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have caused this Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement to be executed as of the date stated above.</SPAN 94>
<SPAN 95>FOR [insert name of participant or potential or current partner]</SPAN 95>
<SPAN 96>[insert name of representative]</SPAN 96>
<SPAN 97>[insert title]</SPAN 97>
<SPAN 98>Done at [place] on [date]</SPAN 98>
<SPAN 99>For more information, please consult our fact sheets on “How to manage confidential business information” and “Non-disclosure agreement: a business tool” which are available in our online library:</SPAN 99>
